title: WebUI is unavailable right now
description: The server is responding, but the web interface files are not ready. Restore them to access WebUI again.
logs_body: KiraAI normally downloads the interface files at startup. Check the logs for download, extraction, or file access errors.
restart_title: Resolve the issue, then restart KiraAI
restart_body: Check that the download source is reachable and address any file or permission errors in the logs. Restart KiraAI to check and prepare the interface files again.
refresh_note: Refresh after fixing the issue and restarting. Refreshing does not download files again.
manual_body: Download dist.zip for your current KiraAI version. Extract all contents, including .version, into the interface directory (data/dist by default), with index.html and assets directly inside it. If you use --data-dir or --webui-dir, follow your startup configuration. Restart KiraAI when finished.
source_body: To build from source, run npm install and npm run build in webui/frontend. The output is in webui/static/dist. For development, run python main.py --webui-dir webui/static/dist --ignore-webui-version-check from the project root to use the local build without a version check.
visitor_note: If you do not manage this deployment, share this page with your administrator.
